correctness.rationale: Dimensionless reversible Langevin generator L=∂²−V'∂ with V=x⁴/4−ρx²/2 and stationary Gibbs density gives the Poisson-energy formula F=2Z^{-1}∫e^V J². Direct substitution yields J(x)=(√π/2)e^{ρ²/4}erfc((x²−ρ)/2) and a square-integrable corrector. After u=x² the partition function Z=e^Q∫u^{-1/2}exp(−(u−ρ)²/4)du has Gaussian-saddle coefficients a_k=(4k)!/[16^k(2k)!k!], as does the interior barrier integral B=∫_{−√ρ/2}^{√ρ/2}exp(−ρx²/2+x⁴/4)dx under x=√(2/ρ)z. On the barrier J is √π e^Q times a negligible error, and outside it the integrand is exponentially subdominant compared with π e^{2Q}B, so arbitrary fixed-order Laplace expansion makes the two full algebraic series cancel in 2πe^{2Q}B/Z. Therefore F=√2 π exp(ρ²/4)(1+O_N(ρ^{-2N})) for every fixed N, with no stronger uniform-N or exponential-error assertion. Independently derived the two coefficient formulas and verified exact equality for k=0,...,9 using rational arithmetic; high-order finite checks corroborate only the coefficient identity, not the Gaussian tail estimates.

value.rationale: The exact absence of every inverse-power correction for a natural double-well additive diffusion and its integrated phase is a delicate analytic rigidity statement: two separately nontrivial full saddle series cancel. Knowing this exact asymptotic structure changes high-barrier approximation practice and distinguishes normalized correlation times from physical phase-variance growth. The known integral alone does not make the cancellation a routine textbook deduction.

limitations: Only symmetric quartic stationary potential, additive noise, unwrapped linear phase and fixed-order asymptotic errors.
All-orders cancellation does not claim exponentially sharp uniform remainder; priority of previously known exact integral fully credited.
